question: Recruiting Phase 3 trials of semaglutide for heart failure?

route.reason: The question asks for recruiting Phase 3 trials of semaglutide in heart failure, which is answerable from ClinicalTrials.gov registry records (phase, status, condition).

draft.text: The registry count for recruiting Phase 3 semaglutide trials in heart failure is 3 [count:2]. Of the trials listed, two include semaglutide as an intervention: NCT06082063, "Multifactorial Intervention to Reduce Cardiovascular Disease in Type 1 Diabetes", Phase 3, Recruiting [trial:NCT06082063]; and NCT06423599, "Effect of Weight Loss on Physical and Cardiac Performance in People With Obesity and Heart Failure", Phase 2/Phase 3, Recruiting [trial:NCT06423599]. NCT07223242, "Tailored Exercise Training Study Among Adults With HFpEF", Phase 2/Phase 3, Recruiting, was also returned, but its listed interventions are exercise training and weight loss and do not name semaglutide [trial:NCT07223242]. The evidence does not say which trials the count of 3 comprises, so the list may not match it exactly.
